rules.statement: A person who was not a party to the partition action can intervene and have an interlocutory decree set aside if lis pendens was not properly registered, even after the decree is entered.
rules.supporting_quote: "In considering the effect of section 48 (3), Sinnetamby, J., said at 503, 'In the case of persons who are not parties to the action, however, sub-section 3 provides, inter alia, that the fact that the lis pendens had not been properly registered would deprive the decree of its final and conclusive effect.'"
